Title: Claude Code extension SSH backdoor - ipv4
Description: Attacker server the tampered extension opens a reverse SSH tunnel to as user tunnel on TCP 22 and posts host details to on TCP 8099. Source: Cursor – Security notice: malicious Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 in the extension marketplace https://cursor.com/blog/claude-code-extension-security-notice; Microsoft Threat Intelligence – Inside a malicious Claude Code-branded extension and its persistent SSH backdoor https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/10/30/inside-malicious-claude-code-branded-cursor-extension-persistent-ssh-backdoor/; Netskope Threat Labs – Trojanized Claude Code extension https://threatlabs.netskope.com/blog/2026/10/trojanized-claude-code-extension; ThreatFox – 134.209.82.225:8099/beacon (IOC 2004556) https://threatfox.abuse.ch/ioc/2004556/
RecommendedActions: Alert-only: validate context before blocking (shared/volatile infrastructure).
